newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi says develops LSI chip for display devices.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi says develops LSI chip for display devices.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd said on Monday it had developed large-scale integration (LSI) chips for use in a wide range of display devices, including plasma displays and liquid crystal displays (LCDs).

The new LSI is a one-chip device that converts various types of input signals, such as regular television signals and personal computer video signals, to a required formatted output signal with high picture quality, the company said in a statement.
A Hitachi spokeswoman said the LSI chips are expected to be put on the market this autumn.
The company plans to launch the product in Japan first and is considering introducing it in overseas markets later.
It has not yet decided on the selling price of the chips, she said.
